definition: Not restricted, controlled, or held back.
author: Charles Dickens
quote: Its dark brown curls were long and free; free as its genial face, its sparkling eye, its open hand, its cheery voice, its unconstrained demeanour, and its joyful air.
example_sentence: The puppy greets the postman with unconstrained joy every single morning.
